_comment: Synthetic Amplify build-notification SNS envelope. Preserves the EXACT real message structure (prose body, app URL then console URL, 'Your build status is SUCCEED') but every identifier is fake — no real app id, account number, ARN, or email. Do not replace with a real notification.

Sns.Subject: AWS Amplify Build Notification
Sns.Message: Build notification from the AWS Amplify Console for app: https://main.exampleappid00.amplifyapp.com/. Your build status is SUCCEED. Go to https://console.aws.amazon.com/amplify/apps/exampleappid00/branches/main?region=eu-central-1 to view details on your build.
